editorial:
You get another round of Gru’s chaotic family life, now with a baby who seems to enjoy making his dad miserable. When old rival Maxime Le Mal breaks out with Valentina, the whole crew has to leave home and hide under new identities. The movie keeps the bright, silly energy of the series, with plenty of minion chaos, family jokes, and fast action. It feels familiar, but the new baby and fresh villain give the story enough spark to keep you smiling.

The action scenes are colorful and fast, and the voice cast keeps things lively from start to finish. Some jokes land better than others, and the story can feel crowded with side plots and minion bits. Still, it is a fun pick for families and fans of the franchise who want easy laughs.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Gru and his family face Maxime Le Mal after he tracks them down. Gru Jr finally stops fighting his dad and helps protect the family, showing he cares. Maxime is defeated and captured, ending his revenge plan. With the danger over, the family returns to normal life, and Gru Jr accepts Gru as his dad. The movie closes on a warm, funny note that ties the chaos together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family comedies with big laughs.
